questions.stem_text: Unlike Mesopotamian writings, the records left by the Maya are principally concerned with:
questions.answer_explanation: The records left by the Maya primarily focus on political and military history, as seen in their hieroglyphic inscriptions and codices, which document the reigns of rulers, conquests, and significant events, contrasting with the broader economic and administrative concerns often found in Mesopotamian writings.

questions.stem_text: Virtually all of the crops important in the European Neolithic:

options.A: were primarily animal products, not plant-based.
options.C: were domesticated before groups became sedentary.
options.D: were domesticated at the same time at communal farms.
options.E: were mainly wild crops that were not domesticated until the Bronze Age.

questions.answer_explanation: The correct answer is based on the fact that the Neolithic agricultural revolution in Europe relied heavily on the introduction of domesticated plants and animals from the Near East, as local resources were insufficient to support the diverse agricultural needs of growing populations.

questions.stem_text: How did Aurignacian technology differ from Mousterian technology?

options.A: Mousterian technology was focused on the production of scrapers.
options.B: Aurignacian technology was primarily used for creating stone tools.
options.C: Aurignacian technology was less advanced than Mousterian technology.
options.D: Mousterian technology produced more usable blade surface.
options.E: Aurignacian technology produced more usable blade surface.

questions.answer_explanation: Aurignacian technology is characterized by its advanced blade production techniques that resulted in longer, more efficient blades with greater usable surface area compared to the predominantly flake-based Mousterian technology.

questions.stem_text: There is evidence that premodern Homo sapiens existed:
